liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Big Boss Man** (3 reviews): Reviewer found the groove here especially enjoyable, one of the few highlights of the weekend; A rare song, in a short first set that closes with a nice Cassidy [14][18][19]
- **Eyes Of The World** (3 reviews): Very long and rather dull, taken as evidence of Jerry's decline; Described as the last Eyes ever played [11][12][18]
- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo** (1 review): Strong opener; Jerry plays and sings well, notably better than the night before [10]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Remembered as decent [19]
- **Samba In The Rain** (1 review): Jerry sounds lost here and plays discordantly, as in parts of Eyes [10]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Jerry sings with great feeling during this one [12]

## Setlist highlights

- **Take Me To The River**: rare: 4 archived performances [22]
- **Big Boss Man**: back after 404 archived shows (1846 days) [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1995-07-06.sbd.larson.35156.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 148 min; rated 3/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd1995-07-06.bk4006.holtz.91322.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 147 min [7]
- **gd95-07-06.sbd.9119.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 143 min; rated 3/5 by 8 [8]. Said about its sound: This soundboard transfer is not great, with noticeable tape hiss; The soundboard copy has an obvious pitch speed problem [10][20]
- **gd95-07-06.schoeps.5452.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 140 min; rated 3.25/5 by 16 [9]. Said about its sound: The audience recording is excellent in quality [11]

## Around the show

- Reviewer sat on the lawn on a nice night; house lights were turned off [18]
- Several people fell through a roof at a motel that day [21]
- Judged better overall than the final two shows in Chicago, though not among the best of 1995 [11]
- Reviewer attended this show plus Deer Creek and Chicago, finding them all rather lame, with Jerry and band seemingly not enjoying huge venues [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-07-06.sbd.larson.35156.flac16**: transferred by Chris Larson; source: S:C>D [1]
- **gd1995-07-06.bk4006.holtz.91322.flac16**: Flac16 transfer from the Holtz source; two tracks (d1t01 and d1t08) have small, minimal flaws left as is [7]
- **gd95-07-06.sbd.9119.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Chris L; source: Soundboard [8]
- **gd95-07-06.schoeps.5452.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Chuck and Troy Richey; source: Audience: Schoeps MK4V [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by D.King Gallery: [Grateful Dead 7/6/1995 St. Louis Backstage Pass](https://www.dking-gallery.com/store/Dead_Pass_950706.html) [23]
